articles.image_title: Stromausfall in Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 4: Beds and blankets are seen at a makeshift German Red Cross (DRK) aid station in a local basketball hall, following an arson attack on power cables on January 4, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack on the cables happened at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal, And caused a blackout affecting approximately 45,000 residents, As well as local businesses, hospitals and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. The Stromnetz Berlin utility company has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents, But others will likely have to wait much longer to be reconnected . According to police, The perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning, The incident is similar to a previous attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025.
